title: Booking and availability calendar
prompt: Design a reservation system where guests check availability and book a vacation rental for a range of dates. (Variants: hotel rooms, event tickets.)
key_points: Prevented double booking in the database (a unique key per listing-night, or a conditional update with a row-count check) inside one transaction
Modeled holds with an expiry enforced on the server and a sweeper that releases them
Put an idempotency key on booking creation
Let search be slightly stale, with the booking transaction as the final check
Handled hot inventory or flash demand (waiting room, per-section rows, serialized writes)
Coordinated payment as a saga with compensation (release the hold, refund)
